title: Most Energy-Efficient Supercomputers: Green500 November 2026
desc: The top ten systems in the November 2026 Green500 list, ranked by energy efficiency on the High Performance Linpack benchmark. This covers eligible TOP500 submissions, not every supercomputer worldwide; some entries are system partitions.

source.name: TOP500 — Green500 November 2026 list
source.note: On 24 November 2026 (Korea time), the AllRanks assistant (Codex) checked places 1–10, system names, countries and Energy Efficiency (GFlops/watts) values against the official November 2026 table and compared the tenth and eleventh results. Coverage is limited to eligible TOP500 submissions and can include system partitions. Efficiency measures HPL performance per watt.
